title: HiddenLens: A Multi-Layer LLM Framework for Detecting and Resolving Hidden Assumptions in Software Requirements
abstract: arXiv:2610.29996v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural-language software requirements often omit assumptions about performance, operating conditions, user behaviour, and domain constraints, affecting architecture, testing, and deployment. If undiscovered until implementation, resolving them is far more costly than addressing them early. Although ambiguity and vagueness are widely studied, less attention has been given to assumptions embedded in requirements that appear clear and reasonable. We propose HiddenLens, a novel six-layer BERT-LLM pipeline and, to our knowledge, the first framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions rather than merely flag ambiguity. Layer 1 uses BERT attention entropy to localise unresolved spans; Layer 2 uses CoT-prompted LLM reasoning to articulate each assumption and its failure risk; Layer 3 uses fine-tuned BERT to classify assumptions into six non-functional requirement categories: performance, security, scalabil

translated_title: HiddenLens：一个用于检测和解决软件需求中隐藏假设的多层大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 自然语言形式的软件需求通常省略了关于性能、运行条件、用户行为和领域约束的假设，这些遗漏会影响架构设计、测试和部署。如果这些假设直到实现阶段才被发现，解决它们的代价将远高于在早期阶段处理。尽管歧义性和模糊性已得到广泛研究，但人们对嵌入在看似清晰合理的需求中的假设关注较少。我们提出了HiddenLens，一个新颖的六层BERT-LLM流水线，据我们所知，这是首个专为检测、分类、质疑和解决隐藏假设而设计的框架，而不仅仅是标记歧义。第一层使用BERT注意力熵来定位未解决的文本片段；第二层使用思维链提示的大语言模型推理来阐明每个假设及其失效风险；第三层使用微调后的BERT将假设分类为六类非功能性需求：性能、安全性、可扩展性等。
tldr: HiddenLens是首个专为检测、分类、质疑并解决软件需求中隐藏假设而设计的六层BERT-LLM框架，能够超越单纯的歧义标记，在早期发现并化解需求中的隐含假设，从而显著降低后期修复成本。
en_tdlr: HiddenLens is the first six-layer BERT-LLM framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions in software requirements, going beyond merely flagging ambiguity to uncover and address implicit assumptions early and reduce costly late-stage fixes.
